about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Passionate about creating exceptional digital experiences
about.para1: I'm a Front-End Developer with a Master's Degree in Computer Engineering, passionate about building modern, scalable, and high-performance web applications.
about.para2: With expertise in React, Next.js, and TypeScript, I specialize in translating complex designs into seamless user experiences. My background in computer engineering gives me a strong foundation in algorithms, system design, and software architecture.
about.para3: I'm deeply committed to performance optimization, accessibility, and writing clean, maintainable code. Every project I work on is an opportunity to push the boundaries of what's possible on the web.
